name: Unlimited Defense 无限防卫
detailed_description:
Innovative targeting and shooting mechanics, a unique "Marksmanship" system, fully customizable firearms with operable components at every stage, and personalized magazines and ammunition. – the tactical shooter “Unlimited Defense” is coming soon.

In the fictional Tussan City,Citizens can participate in various firearms competitions and related activities in reality, can also use the "Editor" to create their own worlds, or experience various "scenarios".

A、The shooting range mode：

You will utilize highly customizable firearms paired with ‌dynamic shooting mechanics‌, delivering a deeply immersive and varied gameplay experience.

You can engage in ranked matches, play for fun, compete with friends, or battle with strangers.

Most importantly, you can customize your own shooting range and experience those of your friends or others.

Multiple rules are available: IPSC-style, IDPA-style, USPSA-style, PCSL-style,3Gun-style, CQB, Double Tap... ...

 

 

 

Various firearms: Classic、Open、Production、Production Optic、PCC、Revolver、Standard... ...

Classic, Open, Production, Production Optic, PCC, Revolver, Standard... ...

 

 

 

Various targets: bullseye, popper, A4 target, moving, animal, Mickey Mouse target, Texas Star, flying disc, simulation

 

 Almost all optical characteristics of sights are reproduced: Open sight, Aperture sight,Ghost ring sight， Red dot, Holographic,Collimator, Prism, ACOG, Combination sights, Telescopic sights, etc.

The entire series of firearms :

Every single round of ammunition can be customized：

B、Editor Mode:

Players can experience various "scenarios" and also create their own "scenarios" and "worlds".

The official team will also provide various assets.

 C、Marksmanship：

Learning and equipping various Marksmanship:

Different gun-holding postures,

Different shooting sensations,

Different special shooting modes,

Different recoil control,

Different speeds and techniques,

The same gun, different shooting methods offer different experiences.

 

          Weaver                                                  C A R                                           Warlord

Tired of projectiles cluttering your screen's corner?‌
‌Experience the revolutionary "Gun shooting game" —‌
A ‌groundbreaking shooting experience‌ that strips away distractions and focuses ‌entirely on your weapon‌:

‌Reload‌ | ‌Safety‌ | ‌Rack‌ | ‌Front Sight‌ | ‌Rear Sight‌ | ‌Align‌ | ‌FIRE!‌

‌Coming Soon‌ — ‌Wishlist Now!‌
A ‌secret mode‌ awaits… Stay tuned for revelations!

  • OS: win10
  • Processor: intel i5 9600k/AMD 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIAGTX1060 6g/AMD 5600XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
